llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define and register a ProductDetails screen route in the stack navigator.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: ProductDetails is defined as a screen component and registered in StackScreens.screens.ProductDetails

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must pass a title param when navigating from list to product details.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Navigation to ProductDetails passes a product object param but no title param

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must handle missing productId with a deterministic fallback display instead of showing stale or undefined values.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Missing product is handled with a deterministic fallback text 'No product provided.' instead of rendering undefined values

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use useNavigation to get the navigation object.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useNavigation() is called in both ProductDetailsScreen and ProductsScreen to obtain the navigation object

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createStaticNavigation is called on a plain object (StackScreens) rather than on a navigator created with createNativeStackNavigator's static API; the Stack navigator instance is created but never passed to createStaticNavigation
evidence: const Navigation = createStaticNavigation(StackScreens) — StackScreens is a plain object, not the Stack navigator
